title: Short Rib Ragù Pasta
description: Beef short ribs braise low and slow in red wine, San Marzano tomatoes and fresh herbs until the meat falls off the bone into a rich, glossy ragù. A Sunday-supper showstopper that feeds a crowd.
swaps: Use egg-free GF pasta (wide shapes like GF pappardelle or rigatoni work best).

title: 20-Minute Penne Arrabbiata
description: Hand-crushed San Marzanos and fresh cherry tomatoes simmer with smashed garlic and chili flakes into a fiery, bright 'angry' sauce. Pure olive-oil Italian simplicity, on the table in 20 minutes.
swaps: Use egg-free GF penne.

title: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with Garlic Chips
description: The Roman midnight classic, upgraded: golden fried garlic chips and crunchy toasted crumbs top spaghetti glossed in garlicky olive oil, chili and parsley. Simple pantry ingredients, restaurant-level crunch.
swaps: Use egg-free GF spaghetti and GF breadcrumbs for the topping.
watch: Check seasoned breadcrumbs for egg and dairy.

title: One-Pot Pasta e Fagioli
description: A cozy Italian bean-and-pasta soup with sweet cherry tomatoes, creamy white beans and little ditalini all cooked in one pot. Thick, rustic and deeply comforting.
swaps: Use egg-free GF ditalini or small GF pasta; skip the Parmesan (or use nutritional yeast) and serve with GF bread instead of sourdough.
watch: Check veggie stock for dairy and wheat.

title: 30-Minute Sausage & Peppers Pasta
description: Italian sausage, roasted red peppers, black olives and herby tomatoes come together in a quick, saucy pasta built to be top-allergen-free from the start. A crowd-pleasing weeknight winner.
watch: Check Italian sausage and chicken broth labels for gluten, dairy and fillers.

title: Vegan Pasta Puttanesca with Kale
description: Briny olives, capers and white wine build a punchy tomato sauce, with dulse flakes standing in for the anchovies and fresh tarragon and kale adding a modern twist. Bold, fast and surprisingly elegant.
swaps: Use egg-free GF penne.

title: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto Pasta
description: A blitzed pesto of sun-dried tomatoes, basil, hemp seeds and nutritional yeast turns GF fusilli rosy, creamy and savory with zero nuts or cheese. Ten minutes start to finish.

title: Vegan Stuffed Shells with Tofu Ricotta
description: Jumbo shells are piped full of a fluffy tofu 'ricotta' made with hummus and nutritional yeast, then baked in marinara until bubbly. Cheesy-tasting comfort food with no cashews in sight.
swaps: Use GF jumbo shells (or roll the filling in cooked GF lasagna noodles).
watch: Check hummus and marinara labels for dairy or nuts.

title: Vegan Baked Ziti
description: A smoky, meaty TVP tomato sauce and a velvety nutritional-yeast white sauce get layered with ziti and baked into a creamy, family-sized casserole. All the comfort of the classic, no dairy required.
swaps: Use egg-free GF ziti, a GF 1:1 flour for the white sauce, and GF tamari for the soy sauce.
watch: Check TVP and vegan beef stock for gluten.

title: Butternut Squash Lasagna
description: Thin slices of roasted butternut squash stand in for noodles, layered with herby tofu ricotta, garlicky mushrooms and spinach and a cheesy nooch tomato sauce. Naturally gluten-free and gorgeous for a fall dinner.

title: Butternut Squash Mac and Cheese
description: Silky roasted butternut squash blends with nutritional yeast, Dijon and plant milk into a golden cheese sauce with no nuts at all. Bake it under crunchy crumbs for the full mac experience.
swaps: Use egg-free GF macaroni, oat or soy milk, and GF panko (or skip the crumb topping).

title: Sweet Potato Pasta with Smoky Breadcrumbs
description: Sweet potato, tahini and mellow chickpea miso blend into a creamy, thyme-scented sauce that clings to every noodle. A smoky paprika crumb topping adds crunch.
swaps: Use egg-free GF pasta, GF breadcrumbs, and the recipe's nut-free option of ground pumpkin seeds instead of ground almonds.
watch: Use chickpea or brown rice miso, not barley miso.

title: One-Pot Creamy Butter Bean & Fennel Pasta
description: Fennel, white wine, capers, dried mushrooms, miso and a little torn nori cook down with butter beans into a creamy, deeply savory one-pot sauce. Chef-y flavors with weeknight effort.
swaps: Use egg-free GF pasta (add extra stock if it absorbs more liquid).
watch: Use a barley-free miso and check stock labels.

title: Creamy Lemon Tahini Pasta with Spinach
description: Tahini, lemon and garlic whisk together with starchy pasta water into a silky sauce that wraps around cavatappi and wilted spinach. Bright, nutty-tasting and nut-free.
swaps: Use egg-free GF cavatappi or spirals.

title: Gluten-Free Vegetable Lo Mein
description: GF spaghetti tossed in a sweet garlic-ginger soy glaze with mushrooms, peppers, snow peas, water chestnuts and baby corn. Faster than takeout and built for allergy families.
swaps: Use GF tamari for the soy sauce.

title: Thai Drunken Noodles (Pad Kee Mao)
description: Wide rice noodles get wok-tossed with soy curls or tofu, Chinese broccoli, baby corn, bird's eye chili and a fistful of Thai basil. Spicy, smoky and slurpable.
swaps: Use GF tamari for the light soy sauce and a GF dark soy (or tamari plus a little molasses) for the dark soy.
watch: Vegetarian mushroom sauce and vegan fish sauce often contain wheat. Choose GF versions.

title: Vegan Sesame Tantanmen Ramen
description: A rich, creamy broth of Japanese sesame paste, soy milk and chili oil is topped with spicy miso tofu mince, cabbage, sprouts and corn. Japan's take on dan dan, made peanut-free.
swaps: Use GF rice ramen and GF tamari for the soy sauce; skip the crushed-peanut garnish (extra sesame seeds instead).
watch: Use a barley-free miso. Check that the chili oil is peanut-free.

title: Vegetarian Singapore Noodles
description: Thin mei fun rice noodles are stir-fried golden with curry powder and turmeric plus shiitakes, leeks, napa cabbage and peppers. No shrimp, egg or soy sauce in this one.
swaps: Use dry sherry instead of Shaoxing wine.

title: Vegetarian Laksa
description: A fragrant red-curry coconut broth with sambal and curry powder, ladled over rice noodles with green beans, tomatoes and fresh herbs. Fiery, creamy and soul-warming.
swaps: Use rice vermicelli; skip the optional boiled egg.
watch: Many red curry pastes contain shrimp paste. Choose a shellfish-free one (e.g., Thai Kitchen) and check the broth.

title: Phở Gà (Vietnamese Chicken Pho)
description: Charred onion and ginger plus toasted star anise, cinnamon and coriander perfume a clear chicken broth poured over silky rice noodles. Pile on herbs, sprouts and lime.
watch: Hoisin is usually made with wheat. Use a GF hoisin or skip it.

title: Mee Gati (Thai Coconut Gravy Noodles)
description: A lesser-known Thai street dish: thin rice vermicelli stir-fried in a sweet, tangy, rosy coconut gravy of fermented soybean, tamarind and red fermented tofu, finished with sprouts and garlic chives. A real adventure for noodle lovers.
swaps: Use GF tamari for the thin soy sauce; skip the optional Omnipork.
watch: Check fermented soybean paste (tao jeow) and red fermented tofu labels for wheat.

title: Homemade Gluten-Free Vegan Gnocchi
description: Pillowy potato gnocchi made with GF flour and potato starch, no egg needed. Make a big batch, freeze some, and pan-sear them crispy.

title: Vegan Gluten-Free Pea & Mint Ravioli
description: An egg-free chickpea-flour and tapioca dough is wrapped around a spring filling of peas, leek, mint, miso and lemon. Delicate, bright and seriously impressive.
swaps: Thicken the filling with GF breadcrumbs instead of ground almonds; finish with olive oil or a nut-free pesto.

title: Gluten-Free Vegan Dumplings (Gyoza)
description: A stretchy rice-flour and tapioca dough (it doubles as pasta dough) is folded around a tamari-seasoned veggie and mushroom filling, then pan-fried or steamed. A fun hands-on project for dumpling night.
swaps: Fry in sesame or neutral oil, not peanut oil.

title: Purple Sweet Potato Gnocchi with Tahini Parsley Sauce
description: Vivid violet gnocchi made from just purple sweet potato and arrowroot, tossed in a garlicky tahini-parsley sauce. Stunning on the plate and free of all top allergens.
swaps: Use oat or soy milk (or water) in the sauce.

title: Homemade Chickpea Flour Pasta
description: A protein-rich, egg-free fresh pasta made from chickpea flour, water and a little tapioca, rolled and cut into ribbons by hand or machine. Pairs with any sauce in this collection.

title: Gnocchi with Sunflower Kale Pesto & Crispy Sweet Potatoes
description: Pan-fried homemade potato gnocchi meets a bright kale pesto made with sunflower seeds and nutritional yeast, plus crispy paprika sweet potatoes. A colorful, nut-free twist on pesto gnocchi.
swaps: Use a GF 1:1 flour (with xanthan gum) instead of all-purpose flour for the gnocchi. If using leftover mashed potatoes, make them with vegan butter and oat or soy milk.

title: Cold Sesame Cabbage Noodle Salad
description: Brown rice noodles and ribbons of savoy cabbage are tossed in a zippy lime, ginger and toasted-sesame dressing. Crunchy, refreshing and great for meal prep.
swaps: Use GF tamari or coconut aminos for the liquid aminos.

title: Rainbow Noodle Salad with Ginger Soy Vinaigrette
description: Soba noodles with a confetti of red cabbage, peppers, carrots, cucumber and yellow tomato in a fruity coconut-water, ginger and sesame vinaigrette. Picnic-perfect and feeds a crowd.
swaps: Use 100% buckwheat soba and GF tamari for the soy sauce.
watch: Most soba noodles contain wheat. Buy 100% buckwheat soba labeled gluten-free.

title: Thai Glass Noodle Salad (Yum Woon Sen)
description: Slippery mung-bean glass noodles with crisp cucumber, carrot, cabbage and sprouts in a tangy tamari-lime-ginger dressing. Light, crunchy and ready in under half an hour.
swaps: Skip the peanuts. Top with toasted sunflower seeds or extra sesame seeds instead.
